hero.title: Webdesign that makes your brand seen.
hero.description: Before anyone reads your copy, they see your website. Good webdesign decides in seconds whether trust is built — or not.

principlesSection.title: Design that does more than just look good.
principlesSection.description: For us, webdesign isn't decoration. It's meant to achieve something specific.

items.title: Clarity
items.description: Visitors understand at a glance who you are, what you offer, and what to do next.

items.title: Recognisability
items.description: Typography, colour and imagery come together into a presence that fits you and stays memorable.

items.title: Trust through design
items.description: A considered layout feels premium — before a single word is read.

industriesSection.title: Industries where design makes the difference.
industriesSection.description: Wherever perception drives trust, strong design pays off the most — beauty and wellness, lifestyle brands, and premium services among them.

items.title: Beauty & wellness
items.description: A premium look instantly raises perceived value and trust with your audience.

items.title: Personal brands & studios
items.description: A distinctive visual style makes you recognisable — instead of interchangeable.

approachStatement.title: Design with intent, not by accident.
approachStatement.description: Every decision — spacing, type size, colour — has a reason behind it. Nothing feels arbitrary.

proofSection.title: What that looks like in practice.
proofSection.description: An example from our work: a stylish, editorially designed website for a music label with a strong visual identity.

faq.title: What you'd want to know beforehand.

items.question: What's the difference between webdesign and web development?
items.answer: Webdesign is the visual side — layout, typography, imagery. Web development is the technical build behind it. Both go into every project we do.

items.question: Do I get several design directions to choose from?
items.answer: We develop one considered design direction that fits your brand, then refine the details together with you.

cta.title: Ready for a presence that works?
cta.description: Tell us a little about your brand — we'll show you how we'd bring it to life visually.
